name: Mahjong Club KC (Open Play at Blair & Blythe)
description: KC Mahjong Club (founder Katie Duffy) runs group lessons and open play at partner shops including Blair and Blythe (Westwood KS). Its own classes page says: "For just $125 per person (which includes your NMJL card), you can learn the basics of American Mahjong."
schedule: Session dates/times are on the Blair and Blythe registration page (blairandblythe.com/collections/kc-mahjong-club-lessons); lesson bundles listed as $125 per person; open play price not stated
